instruction: A candid family photograph in a medium full shot captures an energetic pillow fight in a bright bedroom with a yellow headboard. The young girl in the yellow dress (R1) jumps high on the bed on the right, swinging a pillow playfully with a joyful expression. On the left, the man in the yellow sweater (R2) stands by the bed, holding a large white pillow directly in front of his face to shield himself from the impact. The room is bathed in soft, warm indoor light, highlighting the cheerful yellow and white tones.
